title: A few dozen UAP reports are real, some known from inside government

tellings.quote:
Yes. In that we believe when you look
at all the many thousands of reports and
we've looked at all and some I have
guilty knowledge of from when I was
inside the government

plain: After going through many thousands of reports of unidentified flying objects, a small number, a few dozen, hold up as real, and some of them he knew about firsthand from inside the government. That is what Eric Haseltine, a former US intelligence official, tells Jesse Michels. He says he has "guilty knowledge" of some cases from his time inside, mentions a colleague named Chris Gilbert, and credits a book called The New Science of UFOs, so the claim comes from someone who says he saw the material himself.
